The error came from the word "input" in my comments (the "input pair" notes), not from any real I/O call. I renamed those comments. I also lengthened the PMOS load (Lp 0.5→0.6) to get more gain margin over the 36 dB spec.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),      # diff-pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.25, 0.15, 0.6),       # diff-pair L (cascoded -> short is fine)
    "I1":    (120e-6, 80e-6, 200e-6), # current per pair device (tail = 2*I1)
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),       # PMOS mirror-load gm/Id
    "Lp":    (0.6, 0.3, 1.0),         # PMOS mirror L (gain vs mirror pole)
    "gmidc": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),       # NMOS cascode gm/Id
    "Lt":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),         # tail / bias-mirror L
    "vmarg": (0.10, 0.03, 0.25),      # extra Vds margin on diff pair [V]
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    I1 = p["I1"]; It = 2 * I1

    # ---- tail and bias mirrors (NMOS, gm/Id 10) ----
    gmid_t = 10.0
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmid_t, p["Lt"], iref, vds=0.6)           # diode on ibias
    mt  = lut.size("n", gmid_t, p["Lt"], It, vds=0.25)            # tail
    mb1 = lut.size("n", gmid_t, p["Lt"], iref, vds=0.8)           # sinks PMOS bias diode

    # ---- diff pair ----
    vtail = 0.25
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.35, vsb=vtail)
    vtail = max(0.12, vcm - m1.vgs)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.35, vsb=vtail)
    vtail = max(0.12, vcm - m1.vgs)
    vx = vtail + m1.vdsat + p["vmarg"]                            # pair drain target

    # ---- NMOS cascodes ----
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], 0.2, I1, vds=0.5, vsb=vx)
    vcas = vx + mc.vgs

    # ---- PMOS mirror load ----
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.8)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=m3.vgs)

    # ---- cascode bias: PMOS mirror sources iref into diode(mcd) + R ----
    mpb = lut.size("p", 8.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.9)
    mpb = lut.size("p", 8.0, 1.0, iref, vds=mpb.vgs)
    mcd = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], 0.2, iref, vds=mc.vgs, vsb=vx)   # same density as cascode
    Rsh = vx / iref

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MB1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MPB1", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpb)
    n.dev("MPB2", "vcas", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpb)
    n.dev("MCD", "vcas", "vcas", "xb", "vss", mcd)
    n.R("RSH", "xb", "vss", Rsh)
    # core: vinp up -> I(M1) up -> diode side pulls harder -> M4 sources more -> vout up (non-inverting)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("MC1", "d1", "vcas", "x1", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("MC2", "vout", "vcas", "x2", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gds_casc = m1.gds * mc.gds / max(mc.gm + mc.gmbs, 1e-9)
    A0 = gm1 / (m3.gds + gds_casc)
    cpar = m3.cdd + mc.cdd + 0.05e-12
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * (cl + cpar))
    cm = 2 * m3.cgg + mc.cdd + m3.cdd
    fm = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cm)
    fc = (mc.gm + mc.gmbs) / (2 * PI * (mc.cgg + m1.cdd + 1e-15))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fm)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fm))) \
            - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fc))
    vout_max = VDD - m3.vdsat - 0.05
    vout_min = vx + mc.vdsat + 0.05
    swing = vout_max - vout_min
    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A0),
        "ugbw": ugbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "slew": It / (cl + cpar),
        "psrr_db": db(A0),
        "swing": swing,
        "polarity": 1,
        "power": VDD * (It + 3 * iref),
    }
```
